info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Meetings Meetings Reschedule-v3-spec
info.description: The Meeting Rescheduling API provides a mechanism for users to adjust the timing of their existing meetings. This endpoint allows for the modification of meeting schedules, ensuring that participants can accommodate changes in availability. Typically utilized by scheduling applications, team collaboration tools, and productivity platforms, it enhances user flexibility and reduces conflicts. Integrators can leverage this API to provide seamless meeting management experiences for their end-users.

put.summary: Reschedules a meeting to a new date and time.
put.description: This endpoint allows users to change the scheduled date and time of an existing meeting. Ensure that the new schedule does not conflict with other meetings, and that all participants are notified of the changes made.

requestBody.description: Request body for rescheduling a meeting. This should include the necessary details such as the new date and time, along with any optional comments or details relevant to the rescheduling process.

200.description: The meeting has been successfully rescheduled.
